text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations of the "Aoharu Cup" 
to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, would you like to hear an 
explanation about the 'Aoharu Cup'?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of things I'd like to ask about 
the Aoharu Cup—
choice_data_list: About Aoharu Training with Team Members

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Aoharu Cup is a team competition 
hosted by Tracen Academy, held in parallel 
with the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
While individual strength is tested in the 
Twinkle Series, teamwork is what matters 
most in the Aoharu Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the Aoharu Cup is broadly 
divided into the "Pre-season" and the 
"Finals."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During the preseason, you will compete in 
4 team matches to determine your "Team 
Rank."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For more details on Team Ranking, please 
check "About Team Information"♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There is plenty of time during the 
preseason. Let's train our team members 
during that period!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, "Aoharu Training" is 
recommended for training team members!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aoharu Training is also explained in 
detail in "About Team Members and Aoharu 
Training." Please be sure to check it out♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once the preseason ends, the finals are 
finally here! We will decide the winning 
team of the Aoharu Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Even if you don't achieve your desired 
results in the preseason, you can still 
win the whole tournament with a victory in 
the finals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up until the very end, and do 
your best to win the championship!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation of the 
Aoharu Cup. Is there anything else you'd 
like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Aoharu Cup takes place automatically 
after completing turns in late June and 
late December♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A total of 5 races will be held across 
"Sprint," "Mile," "Medium," "Long," and 
"Dirt."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"You can register a minimum of 1 and a 
maximum of 3 runners per race."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Once the Aoharu Cup begins, teams will be 
formed automatically."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, you can also assemble your team 
yourself, Trainer. Please feel free to use 
that option whenever necessary!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once your team is assembled, select your 
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Winning against the opposing team will 
help the trainee Umamusume grow, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The higher your opponent's 'Team Rank', 
the more growth you can expect for your 
Trainee Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition, your team's Team Rank will 
also see a much greater increase!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, if you lose in the Aoharu Cup, 
your ranking will not increase, so let's 
do our best to seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please try selecting your opponents while 
taking the pre-race predictions into 
consideration as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once your opponents are decided, it's time 
to race. Win the majority of the 5 races 
to claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that... if you can fulfill 
these 3 conditions during the Pre-Season, 
a formidable team will appear as your 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Condition one: Reaching a certain Team 
Rank. Condition two: Reaching a certain 
Team Overall Rating.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Condition three: Having a team member who 
has triggered an Ultra Aoharu Soul Burst!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Defeating a powerhouse team will earn you 
big rewards, and something special might 
even happen in the main tournament...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's build the absolute best team towards 
our victory!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once the preseason ends, the finals await 
us at last!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The team that wins the finals will be 
crowned the champions of the Aoharu Cup."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation regarding 
the Aoharu Cup races. Is there anything 
else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume belonging to your team are 
called "Team Members," Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Your team members currently consist of 
your Trainee Umamusume, <chrname>, and the support 
card members, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However, please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If we run in the Aoharu Cup during the 
preseason, people are sure to gather once 
word gets out!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who join your team can run 
in the Aoharu Cup and participate in 
training with you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, you need to be a little careful 
with Umamusume who aren't in your Support 
Card deck.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You cannot perform Friendship Training 
with them, nor will Hint Events trigger. 
Please keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Next, let me explain how Aoharu Training 
works!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By training in the same facility as your 
team members, you will trigger Aoharu 
Special Training, allowing you to push 
each other to new heights.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Whether an Aoharu Training session occurs 
is determined at random when team members 
appear at a training facility.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When Aoharu Training is available, an 
upward icon will appear, so be sure not to 
miss it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Conducting Aoharu Training will increase 
the basic stats of the team members who 
participated.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, doing Special Training with 
two or more team members will boost the 
training effects for your trainee 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The more team members who join the special 
training, the more effective the workout 
will be, so let's all give it a shot 
together!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the probability of Aoharu 
Training occurring, however...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition to increasing via the Support 
Effect "Hint Rate Up," it also goes up 
with more participants in training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please do keep that in mind during your 
training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, after completing Aoharu Training, 
you may sometimes receive Skill Hints!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And as they continued piling on the Aoharu 
training—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When a team member's feelings reach their 
peak, their burning passion for the team 
can cause their "Aoharu Soul" to burst 
forth!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This significantly raises the team 
members' stats, and your trainee Umamusume 
will also gain skill hints.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's ignite the Aoharu Spirit in lots of 
Umamusume and get stronger together as a 
team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And what's more, what's more...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Team members who have experienced an 
Aoharu Soul Burst may even trigger an 
Ultimate Aoharu Soul Burst during Aoharu 
Training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It seems this is especially likely to 
occur when that team member participates 
in Friendship Training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please rest assured that training sessions 
with an active Ultimate Aoharu Soul Burst 
will never fail, thanks to the sheer 
strength of their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
An Extreme Aoharu Spirit Burst will grant 
you hints for special skills, so be sure 
not to miss out♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation about Team 
Members and Aoharu Training. Is there 
anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Here, I will explain 'Team Ranking,' 'Team 
Overall Strength,' and 'Team Titles.'

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First, regarding team information, you can 
check it on the screen where you select 
training commands.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Team Ranking refers to your team's 
standing during the Aoharu Cup 
Pre-Season."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Winning races in the Aoharu Cup will 
increase your team ranking♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The higher your team rank climbs, the 
higher team morale will rise, enabling 
everyone to perform beyond their usual 
limits in the Aoharu Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best to aim for a higher 
rank!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Overall Team Strength refers to the 
combined power of your team, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This will increase as you strengthen your 
team members through Aoharu Training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When each of the team's basic stats 
reaches a certain level, the training 
level will rise, so let's keep making the 
team stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As the team's basic stats increase, the 
overall team strength rises too. Every 
time it hits a milestone, the clubroom 
gets an upgrade.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It seems that upgrading the clubroom makes 
it easier for highly capable members to 
gather after running in the Aoharu Cup♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Team Titles are team evaluations based on 
both your Team Ranking and Overall Team 
Strength during the Pre-Season."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The higher your team title, the better the 
rewards prepared for you at the ending.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aim for a better team title, and give it 
your all in training and the Aoharu Cup♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
team information. Is there anything else 
you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
